therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction

dose_info.dose: 0.5 mg to 12 mg/week (conventional); 1 mg to 12 mg/week (rapid escalation)
dose_info.schedule: conventional: 0.5 mg once weekly escalated every 4 weeks; rapid: starting 0.5 mg twice weekly escalated weekly to 4 mg/week then every 4 weeks
dose_info.dose_modifications: conventional: incremental 0.5 mg/week every 4 weeks based on PRL values; rapid: 1 mg/week increase every 4 weeks if prolactin not normalized by 8 weeks

results_by_chain.biology_description: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with prolactin-secreting macroadenomas receiving rapid dose escalation of cabergoline

results_by_chain.biology_description: prolactin secretion suppression and tumor volume reduction
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with prolactin-secreting macroadenomas receiving conventional dose escalation of cabergoline
